item.content:encoded:
News / CNBC TV18 /

US Market Crash: Nasdaq enters 'bear market' - 10 things for investors to know IXIC NDX DJI

US markets had a brutal day on Friday amidst intense selling pressure as the AI trade continued to unwind. The Dow Jones fell another 950 points, taking the drop for the week to 4,100 points. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday, while the Nasdaq indices - Composite and 100, fell over 5.5% each.

The Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6% on Friday, capping its worst week since March 2020. At its intraday low, the index had slumped more than 20% from its recent record high, meaning it had momentarily slumped into a "bear market". For the Dow, it was also the worst week since March 2020 with a 8% drop, while the S&P 500 had its worst weekly performance since April 2025.

With Friday's fall, both the Dow Jones and the S&P 500 have entered a "technical correction", meaning a 10% or more fall from the peak. The Nasdaq, has reversed all the gains for the year, and has now turned negative on a year-to-date basis.

Chipmaker and software stocks continued to remain the worst hit on Friday. Nvidia shares fell 14% on Friday. AMD, which fell 8% on Thursday after the short-seller report, fell another 13% the next day. Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius Group fell 12% and 16% respectively, while Micron, Sandisk and Western Digital, the high-flyers of the year on the S&P 500, fell between 12% and 16% on Friday.

Nvidia's troubles just don't seem to end. The stock fell 22% this week, the seventh straight weekly loss reported by the company. The last instance the stock fell for seven straight weeks? During the global financial crisis of 2008. Reuters reported that the US Securities & Exchanges Commission is exploring possible accounting issues at the company.

Anthropic, the biggest IPO of the world on record, had a dream debut on Thursday, listing at a 34% premium to its issue price of $83. However, the sell-off trimmed those gains to 17% on listing day, and knocked off another 8.5% on Friday, taking the stock back to nearly the same as its issue price, closing at $88.91.

Gold prices also continued to slide for the fifth day running, marking their biggest weekly fall since March this year. Fears of the US Federal Reserve aggressively hiking rates to combat inflation, along with a rout in AI stocks, is causing this widespread sell-off, not just in gold, but in other precious and industrial metals as well. Gold is now down 9% for the week, fell to its lowest levels since September 2025, and is decisively below the $4,000 an ounce mark, which many investors felt could be a floor for the fall. Silver is down 15% for the week.

The sell-off in AI stocks has spurred demand for haven assets. The US 10-year yield fell below the 5% mark again on Friday, sliding to 4.95%, while the Yen and the Swiss Franc strengthened against the US Dollar. The Yen gained 0.7% against the greenback, while the Franc snapped an eight-day losing streak. That has prevented the US Dollar index from breaking past the mark of 104, which it currently finds itself near.

While the high-beta names sold-off sharply overnight, investors chose to find some shelter in traditional, old-economy defensive names. Shares of Walmart, Costco, Johnson & Johnson, and Procter & Gamble saw shares gain between 1% to 1.5% overnight, but that could not prevent the 30-stock Dow Jones from falling another 950 points on Friday.

Is the sell-off done? A top technical analyst in the US said NO. Jonathan Krinsky, appearing on CNBC on Friday said that the technical setup doesn't point to the fact that the sell-off is over. He cited Apple, currently the most valuable company in the world, which is only down 3% to 4% from its highs, stating that whenever the S&P 500 has dropped 8% or more from its peak, by the time it makes its final bottom, the average drawdown in Apple has been 23%! He also added that more than 50% of S&P 500 stocks are still above their 50-Day Moving Average, compared to a number below 40% or even 20% when the S&P 500 forms a durable bottom.

item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily

Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily Less than 1 min read

AMZN ANT Amazon.com AMZN dropped 3.87% to $257.37 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 19, the worst move among the Anthropic-linked mega-caps on the day of the AI lab's debut. Consumer discretionary was the weakest S&P 500 sector in a broad 2% selloff. Amazon is Anthropic's biggest shareholder. It holds about 1.94 billion non-voting shares, or 14.6%, after investing roughly $18 billion, Fortune reported from the final prospectus. The commercial tie is even larger. Anthropic has committed $110 billion to Amazon through April 2036, Forbes noted in its analysis, payable regardless of usage, or about $11 billion a year. Amazon already booked $62.9 billion of gains on private investments in the first nine months of 2026, mostly from Anthropic.

At Anthropic's $97.17 close, Amazon's stake is worth about $188 billion, roughly 6.8% of Amazon's $2.78 trillion market value on GuruFocus. That cuts both ways, because each $1 move in Anthropic's shares changes the stake by about $1.9 billion and can whipsaw reported net income. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 93/100, signaling strong profitability and momentum with a balance sheet that is solid rather than spotless. GF Value is $259.88, so the shares trade about 1% below it, fairly valued. The bull case is already in the price. The next test is whether AWS growth in the fourth quarter shows the $110 billion commitment turning into recognized revenue.

MACOM, Amtech, Photronics, Impinj, and Allegro MicroSystems shares are falling, what you need to know 2 min read

What happened? A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session as AI-linked shares continued to pull back. Anthropic slid more than 10% following its debut, failing to revive confidence in the sector's spending boom. Investors had looked to Anthropic's record $81.3 billion initial public offering and Nvidia's quarterly earnings beat under interim CEO Colette Kress to steady sentiment following Jensen Huang's resignation, CNBC reported. Instead, Anthropic's retreat toward its $83 offer price echoed Seaport Research warnings, covered by CNBC, that its valuation demands much faster revenue growth. Separately, Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook warned against delaying rate hikes ahead of an expected December increase. Compounding the concerns, President Donald Trump threatened penalties on overseas U.S. data-center builds as new Commerce Department export-licensing rules weighed on chipmakers. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Northlight Asset Management Chief Investment Officer Chris Zaccarelli told CNBC that persistent price pressures keep the Federal Reserve on course to raise interest rates in December. When benchmark bond yields sit above 5%, elevated equity valuations face immediate discount-rate pressure. item.content:encoded:
News / Chainwire / Bybit's Global User Base Surpasses 90 Million as Company Expands Into Traditional Finance

Bybit's Global User Base Surpasses 90 Million as Company Expands Into Traditional Finance 2 min read

Dubai, United Arab Emirates,, November 20th, 2026, Chainwire Bybit, the New Financial Platform today announced that it has surpassed 90 million registered users worldwide, marking another milestone in its growth as the company expands beyond cryptocurrency trading into traditional financial markets, payments and other services. "Surpassing 90 million registered users is an important milestone, but our ambition goes much further. We are bringing trading, investing, payments and AI together on one platform, giving people more ways to access financial markets and manage their money," said Ben Zhou, Co-founder and CEO of Bybit . "As we expand into more markets, we are also investing in the licences, local presence and infrastructure needed to serve customers in different jurisdictions. Our goal is to make financial opportunities more accessible to people around the world." Expanding Beyond Crypto Bybit's TradFi offering now spans more than 600 products across equities, ETFs, indices, commodities and foreign exchange. Following the October launch of Bybit Stocks, eligible users can access more than 1,000 U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs. By October, Bybit TradFi Perps had recorded over US$180 billion in cumulative trading volume since launching in March. Beyond trading, Bybit AI connects with more than 600 platform services and covers over 1,000 customer support scenarios. Bybit Pay connects users with more than 5,000 merchants across 15+ countries, while over 4 million Bybit Cards have been issued, extending the platform's reach into everyday payments. Expanding Its Global Regulatory Footprint In October, Bybit secured a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) licence from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), covering Exchange Services for spot trading. This adds to five other licensing and regulatory milestones achieved across the European Union, the Cayman Islands, Indonesia, South Africa and El Salvador in 2026. In Europe, Bybit EU GmbH has been authorized as a Crypto-Asset Service Provider under the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCAR) by Austria's Financial Market Authority since May 2025. Further strengthening its European presence, Bybit Payments GmbH secured an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence in August 2026, supporting the expansion of payment and card services. Bybit is also exploring further licensing opportunities in Latin America, including Brazil, as it looks to expand its presence in the region. Strengthening Security and Trust Bybit continues to invest in security and operational resilience. Its security credentials include SOC 2 Type II attestation, independently audited by Deloitte, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and PCI DSS compliance validation. With 100 million registered users on the horizon, Bybit is focused on expanding its international presence, developing its financial services and making more financial opportunities accessible to users around the world.

#Bybit / #NewFinancialPlatform About Bybit Bybit is The New Financial Platform. We believe every person should have access to every financial opportunity on earth. That's why we're building the first intelligent platform that connects anyone, anywhere to the world's finance. Trusted by more than 90 million users worldwide, Bybit brings together investing, trading, payments, and wealth-building in a single secure and intelligent ecosystem. Through the combination of AI-powered technology, deep global liquidity, robust security, and transparent operations, Bybit makes global finance more accessible, efficient, and empowering for everyone.
